headline: Softtech Engineers submits its latest investor presentation to the exchange

headline: Softtech Engineers appoints Nihal Gupta as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer
hook: Leadership change in the compliance desk
summary: Softtech Engineers Limited has announced the appointment of Nihal Gupta as its new Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective November 4, 2026. He will take over statutory compliance responsibilities for the firm. This is a routine corporate governance filing. For Indian retail investors, this administrative update has no direct bearing on the company's financial performance or stock price.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance appointment with no impact on share price.
